Method of Attack: Malicious plugin for Autodesk 3ds Max exploiting a vulnerability in MAXScript scripting utility allowing code execution on Windows systems
Malware that collects host details (computer name, username), steals sensitive information including screenshots, passwords, browser history, and files with specific extensions
Malicious plugin infects other MAX files to spread on the network
Malware sleeps when Task Manager or Performance Monitor are running to avoid detection
Selective file compression to avoid detection
Impacted Systems: Autodesk 3ds Max software on Windows systems
Attack Vector: Malicious plugin loaded in Autodesk 3ds Max exploiting MAXScript vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control (C2) infrastructure in South Korea
Malware samples contacting same C2 in South Korea
